Locally adapted physical Anytown model: nominal pump speeds, realistic candidate pipes and resized distribution/inlet pipes. Positive pressure throughout the 24-hour STACI simulation; initial hydraulic state agrees with EPANET.

local_modifications.authorization: User explicitly requested a reasonable physical INP model.
local_modifications.pump_speed: Pumps 78/79/80 explicitly SPEED 1.0; all 24 multipliers in patterns 2/3/4 changed from 0 to 1.0.
local_modifications.distribution_pipe_diameter_inches: Original 8 -> 12, 10 -> 16, 12 -> 18, 16 -> 24 inches; trunks and candidate overrides above. Existing 30-inch pipe retained.
local_modifications.unchanged_parameters: Topology, demands and demand patterns, pump curves, roughness, lengths, elevations, tank levels/limits/dimensions and timestep settings retained.
